canonical_identity.title: Hindi to Mundari Translation Dataset Corpus
canonical_identity.creator_statement: Microsoft Research India; Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur; Karya; Indo-German Development Cooperation FAIR Forward collaboration

rights.license: Karya Inc. Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike-FreeSoftware 1.0 International Public License (KPL BY-NC-SA-FS 1.0)
rights.incorporation_condition: If Licensed Material is Incorporated as defined by the license, the Incorporator's License must exclusively be GNU GPL version 3 or later.
rights.reason: The corpus is usable only subject to its KPL conditions; the current MLHKP repository licensing/redistribution compatibility and participant/translator consent basis have not been established. Exact external locators can be retained without reproducing corpus text.

same_project_manifestations: Karya project/case-study descriptions when referring to this translation corpus
deterministic_canonicalization.independence_rule: README, payload, license, copyright file, mirrors and project descriptions are manifestations/documentation of one corpus and must not be counted as independent corroborating sources.

exact_locator_policy.record_locator: commit SHA + payload path + 1-based TSV line number
promotion_requirements: obtain immutable payload bytes and compute local SHA-256
deterministically recount rows and validate exactly two tab-separated fields per promoted row
resolve compatibility of KPL BY-NC-SA-FS 1.0 with MLHKP release licensing and software/data separation
retain attribution and license URI/text as required
review translator/participant provenance, privacy/consent and cultural-access implications
promote only linguistic/translation evidence supported by the exact row; do not infer cultural propositions from a translation pair

quality_and_scope.claim_boundary: A row can evidence that the released corpus contains a provider-supplied Hindi–Mundari translation pair; it does not by itself establish a general lexical, grammatical, demographic or cultural claim.

blocked_or_unresolved: local SHA-256 not available through the connected GitHub text interface
17,826 provider count not independently recounted in this run
KPL compatibility with MLHKP distribution not yet established
participant/translator consent and provenance not independently audited

promotion.reason: Rights/license compatibility, local hash/recount, and consent/provenance gates remain unresolved; copying rows would overstate permission.

audit_invariants_added: public GitHub payload does not equal unrestricted redistribution permission
KPL-licensed translation pair does not equal cultural claim
provider row count does not equal independently audited row count
project README, TSV, license, copyright and case study do not equal independent sources
exact external locator does not require reproducing licensed text
